content.text: Everyone, take a look at this corner of my house—it's piled high with clutter, and I really don't know where to start.
@Una You might consider storage boxes; I previously posted about IKEA's white plastic bins.
Vivi, I just looked at that plastic box, and it doesn't really match the style I'm going for.
Una, look at this designer brand solid wood chest of drawers; the style is really nice.
@Chloe This dresser is really nice, but I'm worried the size might not fit.
@Una, you can use Figure 4 to measure and see if it fits.
Well, I measured with a tape measure, and the corner is only 80cm wide.
That might not fit, because this cabinet is one meter wide.
Una, how about considering adding a floor lamp to create a reading nook?
@Mia That's a good idea, I can give it a try.
I found a similar chest of drawers on Pinduoduo for just one-tenth of your budget.
Great, I've decided to buy this cabinet and paint it myself!
@Una Looking forward to seeing your transformation results!

You can replace it with a handle that has a better texture to enhance the overall effect. If you plan to paint it yourself, remember to sand the surface with sandpaper first. Otherwise, the paint won’t adhere well and may peel or flake off over time.
Okay, I will take your suggestion into consideration.
I measured the corner, and the width is only 80 centimeters, so I need to consider the issue of the power outlet.
@Una The socket is really crucial; we need to find a way that doesn't block it.
I found the dimension drawing for this dresser. Can we see if it can be adjusted?
@Chloe This dresser is 1 meter wide and won't fit, but the design is really nice.
How about trying this floor lamp to create a reading nook?
@Mia This lamp has a nice ambiance. Una might consider placing it in a spot that doesn't block the socket.
The idea for the lamp is good; it could be placed in the corner, which would conveniently avoid blocking the socket.
@Una Then the affordable dresser I recommended can be repositioned to ensure the outlet is not blocked.
@Vivi The dresser you recommended can be painted. Una can DIY it herself, and the color will match the lights perfectly.
Well, DIY painting is indeed a good idea. Let me also consider how to arrange the area around the sockets more reasonably.
@Una, you might consider placing the lamp and the chest of drawers together to create a functional area.
@Una This can also add more layers to this corner, combining lighting with storage.
Good idea, I'll try to make the most of these suggestions to optimize my renovation plan.
@Una Looking forward to seeing your results, they're sure to be beautiful!
Thank you for everyone's suggestions. I will make every effort to ensure the sockets are not obstructed and ultimately achieve a perfect result!
Everyone, take a look at the sketch I drew. I'm thinking of renovating this corner like this.
@Una Your sketch is very creative! However, be careful with the placement of the socket; make sure it's not blocked by the cabinet.
Look at this cabinet. The price is very reasonable, and although it's not as refined as designer styles, the size is just right.
@Vivi I think this cabinet is quite good. Una could consider using it to free up some space for the power outlet.
@Una You may need to leave some space near the socket for easy plugging in.
Okay, I will adjust the position of the cabinet to ensure the outlet is not blocked. @Vivi That cabinet is just the right size, and I'm ready to place the order.
@Una I can help you select some lighting fixtures to create a cozy reading nook.
I've started painting the cabinet, and the process is quite interesting.
@Una It looks like you're really enjoying the DIY process! Looking forward to the finished product.
@Una, remember to pay attention to the position of the socket when installing the handles on the cabinet.
@Una The color looks great, and the paint you chose has a nice texture.
Thank you for all the suggestions! I will pay attention to the socket issue and strive to complete the renovation as soon as possible.
@Una If needed, I can help you find some suitable decorations to match the entire space.
@Una You could also consider hanging some small picture frames above the cabinet to add visual depth.
Great idea! I'll give it serious consideration and show you the final result once I've completed it.
The process of painting is really a challenge!
@Una Looks like you're fully immersed in it. How did it turn out?
@Una, you are so persistent! You look very artistic with paint all over your hands.
Check out the final result!
@Una This corner looks very cozy now, and the lighting creates a fantastic atmosphere!
@Una This renovation is truly successful; the combination of the cabinets and lighting has completely revitalized the entire space.
@Una, you have a great taste in colors, and the decorations on the cabinet are quite eye-catching.
How are the details of the vase on the cabinet?
@Una This ceramic vase paired with dried flowers has a lot of style, adding a significant artistic touch to the overall look.
@Una I really like this simple yet elegant decorating style.
@Una This detail really adds a lot of charm to the entire room. What a great choice!
@Una, you truly have a talent for making spaces feel warm, harmonious, and beautiful.
Thank you for all your suggestions and support. This renovation has been a great success!
Looking at your results, I feel inspired to start renovating my home too!
We can plan some new projects together and look forward to our next collaboration!
@Chloe The handle of this cabinet really has a great texture!
@Una Yes, I think this retro style suits the overall atmosphere of your room very well.
@Una I think these small details really add a lot of charm to the entire space.
@Una, check out this home design reference, it might give you some new inspiration.
@Mia Thank you! These designs look very interesting, and I really want to try more transformations.
@Una I think you could consider adding some green plants on the cabinet, just like in the picture.
@Nina That's a great idea! Plants really bring life to a space.
@Una If you add plants, you might consider some hanging ones to save more space.
@Una I have some great plant recommendations, I can send them to you later.
@Una The lighting effect is amazing, the whole corner looks so cozy!
@Mia Thank you! Sitting here in the evening is truly a pleasure.
@Una This atmosphere reminds me of a certain coffee shop, very cozy.
@Una Speaking of coffee shops, have you considered adding a small coffee machine in the room?
@Una I think this corner could perfectly become your personal little haven. Adding a coffee machine is a great idea.
@Chloe @Vivi That sounds very appealing, I'll consider it!

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): Una展示家里堆满杂物的角落，讨论收纳和改造方案。Chloe推荐的斗柜好看但尺寸不合适，Vivi推荐了便宜替代品。Una决定购买并改造。
(第2段摘要): Una在墙角测量后，讨论如何避免挡住插座的问题。建议包括使用Vivi推荐的便宜斗柜和Mia推荐的落地灯。Una计划DIY刷漆并优化布局，确保插座不被挡住。
(第3段摘要): Una展示了她的改造草图，大家讨论了承诺插座位置不被遮挡的问题，并分享了DIY过程的照片。
(第4段摘要): Una分享了她刷漆过程的照片，并展示了最终改造的房间角落。大家对她的努力和成果表示赞赏，尤其是对柜子和灯的搭配以及细节装饰给予了高度评价。
(第5段摘要): Una对房间的改造取得了成功，大家继续讨论如何进一步美化，包括添加植物和咖啡机等新元素。

解决插座不能被挡住的问题
